Positive controls PC1-PC4 all PASS: PC1 exact-repeat hitRate 1.0 (TERX/Stagehand) at n0 with 50-tok verify; PC2 SPIDER-MEA binding 5/5 per family at n0 via _bind and auditor blocks 100% unverified writes (45/45 blocked); PC3 TTL/ETag probe discrimination accuracy 1.0 (>=0.90), latency saving 0.375 (>=0.30), probeFalseAccept 0.0 (<0.05) with ~50% stale exercising ETag mismatch; PC4 NC2 false_accept 0.120 in [0.10,0.60] proving non-vacuous mock. Measurement apparatus is VALID (not MEASUREMENT_INVALID).

C3 pivot per_hit economics FAILS as reported: SPIDER-MEA/RAG per_hit ratio at n0 = 1.143 (threshold <=0.85), at n0.25 = 0.298 (PASS). SPIDER-MEA/Stagehand at n0 = 1.143 (PASS <=1.20). SPIDER-MEA/TERX at n>=0.25 all ~0.123 (PASS <1.0). Failure at n0 vs RAG is the decisive falsifier per Director REOPEN mandate.

Root cause of C3 failure: MEA auditor fixed overhead dominates at n=0. SPIDER-MEA per_hit at n0 = 50 + (auditor_fetch 100 + distill_amort 100 + auditor_amort 10 + frontier 50 - probe_saving 40)/L = 50 + 220/L. For L=8-14 this yields 65-77 tok/step vs RAG 50 + 50/L = 56-57 tok/step. At n=0.25, RAG per_hit rises proportionally (~208) while SPIDER-MEA stays flat (~62) because frontier adapter reconstructs novel slots at 50 tok (hit) instead of 500 (repair), flipping the ratio.

Frontier adapter exhibits 100% hit_rate_correct_family across ALL novelty levels (n=0 to n=1) with char-bigram Jaccard on synthetic A/B pools (e.g., 'A-SKU-00-0' vs 'B-SKU-00-0' yield Jaccard >=0.7). This is a synthetic artifact: B-pool values share character bigrams with A-pool by construction, so frontier always reconstructs. Correct-family gating (crossFamilyAdoption=0) holds but reconstruction is vacuously easy on this fixture. Does not demonstrate transfer to production DOM where alias families are orthogonal.

TTL/ETag probe hit_rate at n=0 is only ~50% (probe_traces.json shows 96/192 hits at n0) because deterministic fixture seeded 42 assigns TTL/ETag state independent of novelty. At exact-repeat n=0, probe should be fresh (TTL valid + ETag match) but fixture yields ~50% stale. This artificially inflates SPIDER-MEA per_hit at n0 by ~20 tok/step (50 vs 10 probe cost on misses).

Per_hit is nearly constant across novelty for SPIDER-MEA (rho_novelty_per_hit = -0.028, p=0.506). This is because frontier adapter hit rate = 1.0 at all n, converting all novel steps to 50-tok reconstructed hits. The 'residual novelty proportional compression' mechanism is not exercised; cost is flat because reconstruction always succeeds on synthetic fixture.

Strong negative rho_length_per_stratum (-0.75 to -0.85) on M_per_hit confirms per_hit = constant/L artifact (fixed overhead / L). This is expected given per_hit formula and does not invalidate comparison since all systems share same L distribution per family.

However ECE computed with 3-4 empty bins out of 5 (bins 1,2,3 empty on all rows; bins 0,1,2,3 empty on EXEC rows). Confidence_std=0.408 > 0.05 satisfies non-vacuous requirement. B-COLD flat per_hit ~505 across all n (500 novel + 50 verify / L). Serves as upper bound denominator.

claim_ceiling: FALSIFIES: The governed-memory pivot (curated exploration + MEA auditor + TTL/ETag probe + frontier correct-family reconstruction) as implemented does NOT achieve per_hit <=0.85 vs RAG-EMBED at n=0 on this file-based synthetic census. MEA fixed overhead (100 tok auditor_fetch + 100 distill_amort + 10 auditor_amort + 50 frontier - 40 probe_saving = 220 tok fixed) dominates at n=0 where RAG pays only 50 verify + 50/L. At n>=0.25 the frontier adapter's synthetic 100% reconstruction hit rate (char-bigram Jaccard on similar A/B values) flips the ratio to 0.30 vs RAG, but this does not demonstrate residual-novelty-proportional compression on realistic alias families. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS; this specific pivot+adapter combination is REJECTED for the tested setting. No promotion to EXPERIMENTAL or PRODUCT_CORE. Valid negative result with measurement apparatus confirmed valid (PC1-PC4 PASS).
